Card Q&A.q: If my opponent has 5 or fewer cards in their hand, which player gains  from this card’s [On Deletion] effect?

Effect: [On Deletion] If your opponent has 5 or fewer cards in their hand, ＜Draw 1＞ and trash 1 card in your hand. If they have 7 or more, they trash 1 card in their hand.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] While your opponent has 6 or fewer cards in their hand, this Digimon gets +1000 DP.
